ruleFreezeEvidence.description: Frozen hypothesis config was introduced in commit f2598cf960472f368cd6ad25f67d4c97a3b3956e before the first forward capture epoch. Runtime Git is not executed; this reviewed manifest records freeze identity for offline validation.

limitations: Canonical historical discovery artifacts are absent from the checkout, so discovery calibration statistics cannot be reconstructed.
Rule-freeze provenance is established by a reviewed manifest (verificationModel=reviewed-manifest); repository history is not checked at runtime.
First-forward timing is project-context evidence (runtimeVerified=false), not independently verified by the evaluator.
This manifest does not invent or fabricate historical observation counts, calibration errors, or robustness scores.

integrityCorrections.summary: Reconcile explicit probability bounds from the original [0.3, 0.7) discrepancy to the registered coarse-prob-1 exact middle thirds [1/3, 2/3).
integrityCorrections.rationale: The frozen bucket identity was always coarse-prob-1 (exact thirds). Aligning explicit config bounds to the registry removes dual-path eligibility. This is not post-hoc optimization from forward returns, settlements, candidate performance, or event counts.

integrityCorrections.summary: Align frozen classificationRules.precedence with the production classifier canonical order.
integrityCorrections.rationale: Runtime classification was already governed by classifyCalibrationFadeInterpretation hardcoded order (observation-quality before insufficient-events). Updating the freeze metadata removes dual authorities. Behavior was not selected from forward results.
